about_the_game:
Mimic Meadows is an extended version of Mimic Classic. If you enjoyed the original game, please wishlist above to find out when the new game comes out!

Mimic Classic got great reviews, including praise from the creators of Baba Is You and VVVVVV. This has encouraged us to create a new version that explores the mechanic much more deeply. The new game features:

  • A handful of new worlds and biomes

  • Puzzles that explore themes such as eating and mating

  • Beautiful new visuals & audio

  • QoL features like level select and undo

  • Optional extra-challenging levels

  • Secrets and more!

"I really like it when a game takes a weird idea and lets me discover all the funny unexpected consequences of it. 'What happens when I …?' is one of the best questions a game can invite you to ask." 
- Terry Cavanagh’s review of Mimic Classic

Thanks for the support!
sourencho

short_description: Mimic Meadows is a puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows.
